title: ProjectPolicy
description: T07 design note §5.9 and §10.3, ADR 0019 D4. `project-policy.json`: the capability grants of one project and its executor settings. It changes only through audited operator commands, and an invalid file is refused rather than defaulted: a grant must validate before it can confer authority. `capability_id` and every non-null `token_sha256` are unique across `capabilities`; a JSON Schema cannot state either, and `ProjectPolicy.from_document` does.
